original_ai_output.title_zh: 大皮博尔行政区要求南苏丹军方勿将其整体指为儿童贩运者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 大皮博尔行政区（GPAA）政府表示欢迎南苏丹人民国防军（SSPDF）打击儿童贩运，但担忧军方措辞将当地居民和官员整体与该行为挂钩，认为存在偏见。SSPDF此前宣布在朱巴捣毁一个儿童贩运网络，涉及近期23名儿童被拐卖，已逮捕8名嫌疑人，包括前政府官员。GPAA信息部长称，任何前官员若经调查涉案属个案，不应归咎于GPAA政府或整个穆尔勒族群。报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 大皮博尔行政区政府对南苏丹军方打击儿童贩运的措辞表示关切，认为其将当地居民和官员整体与贩运行为挂钩
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: it is concerned that the language used appears to collectively link residents and officials to the practice, a reference it says is biased

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹人民国防军宣布在朱巴捣毁一个儿童贩运网络，涉及近期23名儿童被拐卖
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the SSPDF announced the dismantling of a network of child traffickers in Juba, involved in the theft and sale of 23 children in recent weeks

key_facts.fact: 行动已逮捕8名嫌疑人，包括前政府官员，并追捕在逃嫌疑人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The ongoing crackdown saw the arrest of eight suspects, including former government officials, and a manhunt for suspects still at large

key_facts.fact: GPAA信息部长称前官员涉案若经调查确立属个案，不应归咎于GPAA政府或整个穆尔勒族群
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The involvement of any former public official, if established through investigation, remains a matter of an individual case and must not be attributed to the government of GPAA or the entire Murle Community

key_facts.fact: GPAA称今年6月至8月间解救并送回27名被绑架的妇女和儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the recent rescue and return of 27 abducted women and children of Jonglei, Eastern Equatoria and Central Equatoria states between June and August this year

uncertainties: 关于前官员涉案的指控尚未经调查或法院判决确认
有关皮博尔和古穆鲁克存在公开买卖儿童市场的说法被要求提供可信证据，尚未证实
报道为单一来源（Radio Tamazuj），缺乏交叉验证
